guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table to make a text (a) Friction between teenagers and parents is very common and one of the major problems of the modern age. (b) One obvious reason of friction is the difficult behaviours of the adolescents which are common features of teenagers. (c) Moody and sulky behaviours are the kinds of behaviours that are the result of loneliness. (d) Consequently, adolescents are self-centered and want to think for themselves. (e) They rebel against the ways and thoughts of older generations which they think are outdated.
